## Repository hygiene

- [ ] License present (MIT)
- [ ] Contributing guide present and current
- [ ] Discussion strategy decided and enabled as needed

## Evidence trail

- [ ] Trial registry append-only rows present
- [ ] Campaign registry append-only verdicts present
- [ ] Artifact paths valid and reproducible

## Documentation

- [ ] Methodology includes exact Gate A thresholds
- [ ] Plotting conventions enforced in outputs
- [ ] Fail -> revise model policy stated

## Release notes

- [ ] Declared campaign ids
- [ ] Gate outcomes
- [ ] Known limitations
